description: Write a durable cancellation receipt for one canonical MartinLoop run. Provide exactly one selector: file, loopId, or latest; runsDir changes the run-store root, while reason and requestedBy add audit context. Use when work must be abandoned, not temporarily held. This records a request and does not kill a process; use martin_pause for a reversible hold.

file.description: Path to one canonical run record or directory. Mutually exclusive with loopId and latest.

latest.description: When true, targets the latest canonical run. Mutually exclusive with file and loopId.

loopId.description: Canonical MartinLoop run identifier. Mutually exclusive with file and latest.

reason.description: Optional non-empty reason recorded in the cancellation receipt.

requestedBy.description: Optional human or runtime identity label recorded for audit context.

runsDir.description: Optional run-store root override used to resolve loopId or latest.

name: martin_cancel

action.description: The control action that was recorded.

controlId.description: Unique receipt ID for this control action.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier the control was applied to.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the control, if provided.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the control was recorded.

requestedBy.description: Identity that requested the control, if provided.
